changelog: NEW: Load & Bill Payment module - Mobile Load (Jazz/Ufone/Telenor/Zong) with Purchase/Sale tracking per company
NEW: Bill Payment - Electricity, Gas, Water, Internet bills with separate bill amount (liability) and service charge (income)
NEW: JazzCash/Easypaisa - Send Money & Receive Money with editable service charges
NEW: Load & Bill Reports - Daily cash, company-wise, service charge, profit reports with date filters
NEW: Receipt printing for all Load & Bill transactions
UPGRADED: Shop Cards now have Unique Customer ID and QR Code on every card
UPGRADED: Card scan shows full account details - balance, purchases, payments, status, ledger
UPGRADED: Card transactions now support 8 types: Deposit, Withdrawal, Purchase, Payment, Credit, Debit, Adjustment, Refund
UPGRADED: Manual deposit/withdrawal/credit/debit/adjustment/refund entries on Shop Cards
